name: Adapter
summary: Converts the interface of a type into the interface a client expects, letting types collaborate that could not otherwise because of incompatible interfaces.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Target
roles.summary: Declares the interface the client actually uses.

roles.name: Adapter
roles.summary: Implements the target interface by delegating to the adaptee and translating the calls.

roles.name: Adaptee
roles.summary: Holds the behaviour worth reusing, but exposes it through an incompatible interface.
